artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Holding a Laurel Wreath
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a man from the waist up, positioned in a side profile facing to the left. He has a full beard, medium-length hair styled back neatly, a straight nose, deep-set eyes, and a solemn expression. He is dressed in a buttoned-up garment with a ruffled collar and cuffs. The man is holding a laurel wreath in his hands, placed in front of him. The background features an oval frame with a twist pattern around it. Above the man are the letters "AN" and the number "29," and below the frame is an inscription in a stylized script. The texture of the background suggests it is a printed illustration on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Unknown Man
artworks.artist: Louis Coquin after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated position. He has distinctive facial features including a strong jawline, a mustache, and a short, neatly styled beard. His hair is short, light-colored, and wavy. He is dressed in a dark garment with decorative buttons. Around his neck, he wears an elaborate and large ruffled collar. The background is a simple, dark oval.

artworks.title: Portrait of Man in Oval with Decoration of Winged Figures
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Nikolaus van der Horst
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man facing slightly to the side and gazing directly at the viewer. He has curly, shoulder-length hair, a mustache, and a small pointed beard. He wears an elaborate high-collared shirt with lace details and an ornate coat or armor. The portrait is framed within an oval, surrounded by decorative elements including crossed trumpet-like objects, allegorical figures, and floral and fruit motifs. At the bottom, there is a script enclosed within a scroll design. The engraving has intricate linework and shading.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man facing slightly to his right. He has long, curly hair, distinct facial features, and is wearing a formal outfit typical of the 17th century. The background features a textured pattern and an ornate oval frame, giving it a classic appearance.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and His Son
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: an adult male and a young boy. The adult male has short, dark hair and a full beard, with a pronounced nose and slightly furrowed brow. He wears a richly patterned garment with a large ruff collar and his hand rests on a table. The young boy stands next to the man, also wearing an ornate outfit with a detailed ruff collar. The boy holds a stick or rod. In the background is a dark, textured wall with a family crest or coat of arms displayed in the top right corner, along with scales, a book, and other objects on the table.

artworks.title: Deathbed of a Nun
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying down on a plush surface with draped fabric. The head is propped up on a pillow, and the person is looking upwards. They wear a hat, a large ruffled collar, a long gown, and delicate clasped hands. A small dog is near their feet. The background is draped fabric.

artworks.title: Medallion Portrait of Man in Ruff and  Pointed Beard
artworks.description: The image is a small, circular portrait showing a man's face and upper torso face directly towards the viewer. The man has wavy hair and a neatly groomed beard typical of Renaissance fashion. He has a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and appears to be smiling slightly. He wears a formal black garment with a white ruff collar, popular in the late 16th to early 17th centuries. No visible jewelry or objects are shown, as only his face and part of his upper chest are visible. The portrait is set against an empty background with the parchment's texture providing subtle detail.

artworks.title: Anonymous
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a seated person with curly hair, pronounced eyebrows, and a straight gaze. They wear an elaborate coat with a high collar. The background consists of closely spaced parallel lines, and below the portrait, there is a block of text in French.

artworks.title: Portrait of Boy with Falcon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person with a bird perched on their hand. The individual is facing forward, with one arm bent. They have a youthful face, light-colored hair, and wear a dark cap with a feather. The person wears a dark, textured garment with ruffled collar and cuffs, and a ring on their finger. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Joseph Barth
artworks.artist: Nikolaus Rhein, after Heinrich Friedrich Füger
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the shoulders up. The individual is facing forward, slightly turned to their right. They have prominent facial features, including well-defined eyes, a long nose, and full lips. Their hair is curly and flows beneath a large, wide-brimmed hat with a decorative feather. The person wears a draped cloak or wrap, creating a sense of elegance and formality. The background features a dark, oval frame with an indistinct dark backdrop, focusing attention on the subject of the portrait.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He appears to be in a draped garment, with curly hair falling to his shoulders and a styled mustache. The background includes an ornate oval frame with decorative elements and smaller illustrations at the corners. In the center bottom, there is a crest with the word "BVVRIVS" below it.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man with a Long Beard
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up in an ornate frame. The man has a beard and short hair, is seated with both hands resting on a surface. He wears detailed clothing. The frame features classical elements, a coat of arms, and engravings. Latin text is above the portrait and there are cherubs and scrollwork below.

artworks.title: Man Holding Scroll
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a man from the waist up. The man faces slightly to his left, with his body turned towards the viewer but his face in a three-quarter profile. He has distinct facial features, a mustache, and short, neatly combed hair. He wears a large brimmed hat with a band, a high ruffled collar, and a textured coat with decorative details. He holds a rolled paper in his right hand and his left hand is partly tucked into his coat. There is an insignia with a coat of arms in the upper left corner. The background consists of parallel horizontal lines. Below the portrait is a Latin inscription that reads "Nemo Repente Sapit, Merae AE 52 Anno 1579," accompanied by the initials "IH W."

artworks.title: Clergyman (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing slightly to the right, looking directly at the viewer. He has a clean-shaven face with sideburns connected to wavy hair. He is dressed in formal attire with a dark robe, light-colored tunic, and a white neckband. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain and lightly shaded, with a wide cream-colored margin framing the image.

artworks.title: The Virgin Appearing to a Lady Penitent
artworks.description: The engraving shows a woman kneeling in prayer. She is facing a small stand with an open book, potentially a religious text. The woman has a serene expression with delicate features and a distinctive hairstyle. She wears an intricate gown with puffed sleeves and a detailed pattern, likely signifying a garment of high status. She has a pearl necklace around her neck. Above the bookstand, a celestial scene features a figure resembling the Virgin Mary holding an infant Jesus surrounded by clouds. The background includes columns, an arched window, and French text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Antonia Lotharingica
artworks.description: The image shows a woman facing the viewer. She has distinct facial features, long straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. Her hair is styled in a high, voluminous manner with tight curls gathered at the top. She is dressed in an elaborate garment with a large pleated collar around her neck. There are many small buttons on her clothing, and intricate patterns on the collar. She is holding a decorative fan in her right hand, and wearing earrings. The background has a lined pattern within a circular frame. Latin text surrounds the frame and there is Roman and Latin script at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Jacobus Arminius
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man displayed from the chest upwards, facing the viewer. He has a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a full mustache and beard, and short hair in a receding hairline. He is wearing a dark garment with a white, ruffled collar that reaches up to his ears. The background includes an oval frame with decorative text surrounding the portrait and elaborately written Latin text beneath the frame. The style of the image suggests an etching or engraving with fine detail.

artworks.title: Cesare d'Arpino
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a man's upper body. He is slightly turned to his right but facing forward. The man has distinct facial features, including strong cheekbones, a pointed nose, and a goatee, along with thick, wavy hair styled back. He is dressed in a dark garment with a ruffled white collar, a buttoned vest or coat, and wears a chain with a pendant. The portrait is within an oval frame with intricate designs, a classical head above it, and crossed staff-like elements at the top corners. There is a decorative section below with Latin inscription. The artwork is in black and white with detailed shading and engraved line work.

artworks.title: Thomas Howard, Earl of Arundel and His Wife
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman seated from the waist up. The man, positioned behind a globe, is holding a staff with his right hand. He has facial hair, short wavy hair, and wears a mantle with fur trim, a chain with a pendant, a collar, and patterned drapery over his shoulder. The woman, turned slightly towards the man, has curly shoulder-length hair with a crown, and wears a gown with a fur collar adorned with floral decorations, as well as a pearl necklace. She is holding a compass with her left hand and another instrument with her right hand, resting on a sphere next to the globe. The background features heavy drapery and a stone column, with a sculpture of a figure with a laurel wreath visible on the right.

artworks.title: Andreas Athemstet
artworks.artist: Dominicus Custos, after Hans von Aachen
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's bust. The man is facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer, with a composed expression. His facial features are detailed, including a strong nose, prominent brow, neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and short, curly hair. He is dressed in a buttoned doublet with a high, pleated ruff collar. An oval frame surrounds him with an inscription "ANDREAS ATHEMSTET" and a laurel wreath pattern. Latin text surrounds the frame, and the background is textured with a cross-hatch pattern.

artworks.title: Carolus Clusius, Professor of Botany at Leyden
artworks.description: The image shows an ornately decorated portrait engraving of a man's upper body in an oval frame. The man faces slightly to his left with a receding hairline, a closely cropped hairstyle, and a beard. He wears a garment with a large ruffled collar. On either side of the portrait are two winged figures with floral garlands. The background is detailed with patterns, scrollwork, an emblem, and ornamental vases. Below the portrait is a decorative scroll with inscribed text, against a pattern of fruits, flowers, and shells.

artworks.title: Augustus, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body, centered within an ornate border. He is seated facing slightly to his left but looks directly at the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and beard with medium-length wavy hair. His facial expression is neutral, and his eyes are wide open. The man is dressed in a richly decorated dark garment, featuring a high lace collar and a sash across his shoulder. His attire is elaborately patterned with floral designs and ornate buttons. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with some stippling, giving it a textured appearance, and there is a rectangular border surrounding the rounded portrait. Below the image, there is a text caption with Latin inscriptions describing the man's title and name.

artworks.title: Augustus, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.artist: Conrad Waumans after Anselmus von Hulle
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He faces slightly left with a direct gaze. The man has a long, curled mustache, a full beard, and medium-length hair covered by a cap. He wears richly designed clothing with ornate patterns and a fur-lined collar. The oval frame around him is decorated with intricate designs, including a crest at the top with a crown and various decorative elements like leaves, spirals, and a lion's face. On either side of the frame are allegorical figures, a woman with wings on the left, and a similar figure on the right. Below the oval are depictions of a unicorn and a deer. Under the portrait is a cartouche with Latin text, accompanied by more heraldic imagery and embellishments. The background features detailed engravings consistent with the grandeur of the portrait.
